work.summary: Roving patrol officer responsible for monitoring multiple client properties and responding to security concerns.
highlights: Conducted roving patrols across multiple client properties to identify and respond to security concerns
Responded to trouble calls and incidents throughout an assigned patrol route
Performed periodic checks of on-site security officers and client locations
Documented patrol activity and incidents while maintaining accountability across assigned properties
Maintained accurate trailer location and asset tracking logs using internal systems and spreadsheets
Coordinated assignments between drivers, yard operations, and dispatch schedules to optimize workflow efficiency
Identified and corrected data discrepancies, improving reliability of operational reporting
Authored detailed incident reports and maintained procedural documentation with high accuracy standards
Trained and mentored new personnel on operational procedures and compliance expectations
Demonstrated strong situational awareness, accountability, and decision-making under pressure
Enforced safety, security, and operational procedures in high-responsibility environments
Developed discipline, teamwork, leadership, and consistent execution under structured protocols
